'''Mining rigs''' were two hundred [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long [[Mining/Legends|mining]] vehicles. Requiring a crew of four hundred [[Miner/Legends|workers]], mining rigs had several drilling stations and landing platforms. Mining rigs were manufactured by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]].
